targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts AS time, json_extract(data, 'rpm') AS rpm FROM obd_readings WHERE json_extract(data, 'rpm') IS NOT NULL AND ts >= $__from / 1000 AND ts < $__to / 1000 ORDER BY ts
targets.queryText: SELECT ts AS time, json_extract(data, 'rpm') AS rpm FROM obd_readings WHERE json_extract(data, 'rpm') IS NOT NULL AND ts >= 0 AND ts < 9999999999 ORDER BY ts
